uncertainties: s68-05 seems to frame a different word, or the Name shifted out of the crop; the template locator may have matched the wrong place.
In s70-06, s72-03 and s72-05 the mark above the vav is a slanted stroke that touches or blends into the vav head, so I can't tell a separate holam from the shape of the letter itself.
In every crop the dot sits roughly above the vav head, between the first he and the vav. I recorded it as the holam in question because no crop has a separate dot over the first he's roof.
observations: Each record is based only on its own crop.
In every crop that shows the full Name there is a qamats under the vav, and usually a sof pasuq or another mark at the right edge. These don't affect the holam judgement.
Crop sharpness varies; s64-05, s70-06 and s72-03 are the softest.
